correctness.rationale: The stated Hilbert norm gives the exact compact model D(I-rS)^{-1}. Truncation at bandwidth M has operator norm error ≤r^{M+1}/(1-r). Cutting the band matrix into blocks of length ≈t^{-1/2} yields O(Mt^{-1/2}) cross-cut rank cost. Each block is sandwiched by scalar multiples of a finite Toeplitz section; comparison with circulant and at most 2M trigonometric level crossings yields a uniform O(M+1) block counting error. Monotone Riemann sums give N(t)=κ_M/t+O((M+1)t^{-1/2}). Taking M≈log(1/t) gives N(t)=κ/t+O(t^{-1/2}log(1/t)), which inverts to the asserted individual singular value asymptotic. Elliptic coefficient and its boundary series yield remaining properties. All 80 finite-section/Hilbert–Schmidt checks passed; these are corroborative, not the infinite proof.
